sections.heading: MINOR IN POLITICAL SCIENCE
lines: Faculty of Social Science - Political Science

Completion of first-year requirements, including Political Science 1020E or both Political Science 1021F/G and Political Science 1022F/G or both Political Science 1025F/G and Political Science 1026F/G, with a mark of at least 60%. If upper-year students have not completed 1.0 courses as listed, they may select 1.0 courses from: Political Science 1030A/B and/or Political Science courses at the 2100-2199 level to meet admission requirements, as long as each course is completed with a grade of at least 60%. Political Science courses at the 2100-2199 level used for admission into the Minor may not be counted towards fulfillment of Minor module requirements.
4.0 Political Science courses at the 2100 level or above, of which at least 1.0 must be an essay course (E, F, or G).
